Senses, alerts,
and helps
STOP
Even the best drivers can use a little help. So we created
Kia Drive Wise,* our available, advanced driver-assistance marvels that
are designed to keep you alert and aware of sudden changes in
the flow of traffic ahead of you — and even help you brake if needed.
FORWARD COLLISION WARNING SYSTEM4* DW
Forward Collision Warning System detects slowing or stopped traffic ahead,
and can alert you if you get too close.
AUTONOMOUS EMERGENCY BRAKING4* DW
This system is designed to detect and monitor vehicles ahead of you and
automatically apply the brakes if it determines a crash is imminent.
BRAKE ASSIST SYSTEM
If you suddenly slam on the brakes, it’s designed to sense the urgency
and apply full brake power, which can help shorten your braking distance.
ELECTRONIC BRAKE-FORCE DISTRIBUTION
Based on the vehicle’s weight distribution,
it helps adjust the balance of brake power accordingly.

Rio’s available Rear-Camera Display4* is a feature you’ll use daily
because it helps you see things behind you that you might miss
by simply using your mirrors or looking over your shoulder.
THE REAR-CAMERA DISPLAY TURNS ON AUTOMATICALLY
Just put Rio in reverse and the rear view is designed to automatically
pop up on the bright, high-contrast floating media monitor.
GRID LINES WILL HELP GUIDE YOU
Yellow (getting close) and red (stop!) grid lines appear on the screen to
help you gauge how much space you have before you bump into something.

Even the best drivers can use a little help. So we created
Kia Drive Wise,* our available, advanced driver-assistance marvels that

the flow of traffic ahead of you — and even help you brake if needed.
FORWARD COLLISION WARNING SYSTEM4* DW
Forward Collision Warning System detects slowing or stopped traffic ahead,
and can alert you if you get too close.
AUTONOMOUS EMERGENCY BRAKING4* DW
This system is designed to detect and monitor vehicles ahead of you and
automatically apply the brakes if it determines a crash is imminent.
BRAKE ASSIST SYSTEM
If you suddenly slam on the brakes, it’s designed to sense the urgency
and apply full brake power, which can help shorten your braking distance.
ELECTRONIC BRAKE-FORCE DISTRIBUTION
Based on the vehicle’s weight distribution,
it helps adjust the balance of brake power accordingly.
